label: For "Provider Directory Accuracy Prediction": Predict which provider directory fields such as location, specialty, affiliation, accepting-patients status and contact details are stale or inconsistent, so a health system can target attestation outreach where errors are most likely. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on records where change implies error.
